stories.title: France extends Paris curfew and bans protests in Marseille and Lyon
stories.summary: Paris will keep a partial curfew in parts of the city until Monday, while Marseille and Lyon have imposed a total ban on protests for the weekend. The Louvre, Orsay and Picasso museums will be closed on Saturday as authorities anticipate further demonstrations. The measures follow weekend riots and looting that damaged businesses and historic buildings after protests over the cost of living and school conditions.
stories.why: The restrictions aim to restore public order and protect cultural sites amid the unrest.

stories.title: RBI weighs inflation risks as interest‑rate gap with G7 draws focus, YES Bank forecasts 50 bps hike
stories.summary: The RBI is assessing inflation risks as the interest‑rate gap with G7 economies draws attention. Recent GDP data show the Indian economy remains resilient, supported by strong private consumption and exports. YES Bank forecasts a cumulative 50‑basis‑point rate increase by the RBI in the near term.
stories.why: RBI action or currency-market developments can affect rupee volatility, hedging costs and foreign-exchange conditions for businesses and investors.

stories.title: Indian bond yields rise above 7.45% as oil prices hit $112.50 and RBI lifts repo rate
stories.summary: On Thursday the benchmark yield on Indian government bonds moved above 7.45%. In the same session crude oil prices climbed to $112.50 a barrel in Asian trading amid geopolitical tensions. The Reserve Bank of India raised its repo rate to 5.50% and signalled that further hikes are possible, prompting heightened inflation concerns.
stories.why: RBI action or currency-market developments can affect rupee volatility, hedging costs and foreign-exchange conditions for businesses and investors.

stories.title: Premature twins displaced from Yemen village amid Houthi attack
stories.summary: Twins Raghad Hassan and her brother Raad were born premature just seven weeks ago. When Houthis reached their village in the Kahboub mountains, their family of seven fled amid bombs, missiles, and drone attacks, walking three days before being given a a lift to Aden.
stories.why: Illustrates how the conflict directly endangers civilians, especially vulnerable infants, underscoring the need for humanitarian assistance.

stories.title: OpenAI makes Decisions API widely available
stories.summary: OpenAI released its Decisions API to all customers, repurposing the ChatGPT Luna model to deliver faster, lower‑cost inference. The API cuts typical response times from one‑to‑three seconds to about 100‑180 ms and adds voice and visual modalities, with latency optimizations targeting inference resources worldwide. The launch follows TypeSafe’s Jev model, which created a market for rapid “super‑classifier” decision systems.
stories.why: It provides developers with a quicker, cheaper alternative for decision‑oriented workflows, expanding options beyond traditional LLMs.

stories.title: Canva launches its first AI image generation model, Canva Craft
stories.summary: Canva announced the release of Canva Craft, its first image‑generation model built by its research team. The model works in two stages: first it creates a plan that captures spatial relationships, scale, hierarchy and text details, then it generates images up to 2K resolution in about 30 aspect ratios. It is trained on human‑designed templates rather than photographs and allows precise edits without affecting other image parts.
stories.why: The launch gives Canva a direct AI‑generated image capability, positioning it to compete with established models from Google, OpenAI, ByteDance and Meta.
